## History

Tillie Boulter is a classmate of [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) at the [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) school under the instruction of Mr. [Phillips](../character/phillips.md). She attends class alongside [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) during the time [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) receives public punishment from their schoolmaster.

## Relationships

### [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/anne-shirley--tillie-boulter.md)

Tillie is a friend of [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) who supported her during a conflict at school. She demonstrated her loyalty by taking Anne's side during the dispute among their classmates.
